     6  module

     8  public import Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.KanComplex
     9  
    10  /-!
    11  # Quasicategories
    12  
    13  In this file we define quasicategories,
    14  a common model of infinity categories.
    15  We show that every Kan complex is a quasicategory.
    16  
    17  In `Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/Quasicategory/Nerve.lean`,
    18  we show that the nerve of a category is a quasicategory.
    19  
    20  ## TODO
    21  
    22  - Generalize the definition to higher universes.
    23    See the corresponding TODO in
    24    `Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialSet/KanComplex.lean`.
    25  
    26  -/
    27  
    28  public section
    29  
    30  namespace SSet
    31  
    32  open CategoryTheory Simplicial
    33  
    34  /-- A simplicial set `S` is a *quasicategory* if it satisfies the following horn-filling condition:
    35  for every `n : ℕ` and `0 < i < n`,
    36  every map of simplicial sets `σ₀ : Λ[n, i] → S` can be extended to a map `σ : Δ[n] → S`.
    37  -/
    38  @[kerodon 003A]
    39  class Quasicategory (S : SSet) : Prop where
    40    hornFilling' : ∀ ⦃n : ℕ⦄ ⦃i : Fin (n + 3)⦄ (σ₀ : (Λ[n + 2, i] : SSet) ⟶ S)
"}]
